channel.title: PurgeCore Blog
channel.description: Guides on freeing up disk space, finding what's using your storage, and keeping a Windows PC running smoothly.

item.title: PurgeCore v1.8.3: A Full Code Audit
item.description: A full audit of the codebase found and fixed a Startup Manager desync bug and a leftover from the rename to PurgeCore.

item.title: PurgeCore v1.8.2: Startup Manager and Cookie Whitelist Fixes
item.description: Toggling a startup item twice in a row could silently fail, and cookie whitelist entries pasted as full URLs protected nothing. Both fixed.

item.title: PurgeCore v1.8.0: Uninstall Programs
item.description: A new Uninstall tab lists installed programs, largest first, and uninstalls them using each program's own official uninstaller.

item.title: PurgeCore v1.7.1: A New Typeface
item.description: PurgeCore v1.7.1 embeds Inter as the app's font instead of the default Windows system font, matching the website's typeface for a consistent look.

item.title: PurgeCore v1.7.0: A Real Cleanup Bug Fixed, and a New Look
item.description: A real System cleanup bug fixed (reported freeing space that wasn't actually freed), a bold new colorful design, a separate Blog tab, and clickable drivers with plain explanations.

item.title: PurgeCore v1.6.2: Report a Bug, More Color
item.description: What's new in PurgeCore v1.6.2: a Report a bug button, colored category bars on the Dashboard, and a bouncier button-press animation.

item.title: PurgeCore v1.6.0: Smoother Interface
item.description: What's new in PurgeCore v1.6.0: smooth animated buttons, an animated sidebar, and a fade-in transition when switching tabs.

item.title: PurgeCore v1.5.0: Browser Cleanup Fixes
item.description: What's new in PurgeCore v1.5.0: progress indicators for browser cleanup, accurate freed-space reporting, and a fix for a misleading confirmation message.

item.title: Free Disk Analyzer Is Now PurgeCore
item.description: Free Disk Analyzer has been renamed to PurgeCore. Same app, same free-forever approach, same download, just a new name.

item.title: PurgeCore vs CCleaner: Which One Should You Use?
item.description: An honest comparison of PurgeCore and CCleaner: what each one does well, where CCleaner is still ahead, and where a registry cleaner and paid upsells change the picture.

item.title: PurgeCore vs BleachBit: Which One Should You Use?
item.description: An honest comparison of PurgeCore and BleachBit: open-source privacy cleaning versus disk-space analysis, and where each one is the better fit.

item.title: PurgeCore vs WinDirStat: Which One Should You Use?
item.description: An honest comparison of PurgeCore and WinDirStat: treemap visualization versus a broader cleanup toolkit, and which fits what you're trying to do.

item.title: PurgeCore v1.2.0: Startup Manager
item.description: What's new in PurgeCore v1.2.0: a Startup Manager to speed up boot time and reduce clutter at login.

item.title: PurgeCore v1.1.0: Cleanup That Actually Cleans
item.description: What's new in PurgeCore v1.1.0: safe deletion for duplicates and empty folders, browser cleanup for Chrome/Edge/Firefox, a cookie whitelist, PC cleanup, RAM optimization, and risk indicators on everything.

item.title: PurgeCore v1.0.2: In-App Update Notifications
item.description: What's new in PurgeCore v1.0.2: a banner that appears when a newer version is out, with one-click download and install.

item.title: PurgeCore v1.0.1: Cleanup, Duplicates, RAM, and CSV Export
item.description: What's new in PurgeCore v1.0.1: a Cleanup tab with duplicate finder, old files, empty folders, a RAM optimizer, and CSV export.

item.title: How to Free Up Disk Space on Windows 11: The Complete Guide
item.description: Every place Windows actually hides reclaimable space, from Storage Sense to the WinSxS folder, in the order that gives you the most space back for the least risk.

item.title: What's Taking Up Space on Your Windows PC? How to Actually Find Out
item.description: Why File Explorer's folder sizes lie to you, and the fastest ways to find the real source of a full drive.

item.title: How to Find and Delete Duplicate Files on Windows
item.description: Why duplicates pile up without you noticing, how they're actually detected, and how to remove them safely.

item.title: Windows Storage Sense vs. Third-Party Disk Cleaners: What's the Difference
item.description: What Storage Sense actually automates, where it falls short, and when a dedicated tool is worth using instead.
